attchmntText: Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited published a newspaper advertisement on 07 November 2026 disclosing the extract of Unaudited Financial Results for the half yearly and quarter ended 30 September 2026. The announcement was filed with BSE and NSE under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The Hindustan Housing Company Limited and Kusumgar Limited also published extracts of their Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Kusumgar Limited additionally issued a possession notice under Section 13(4) of the SARFAESI Act 2002 regarding physical possession of property from borrower Rohit Ramesh Gokhale. ABM Knowledgeware Limited and Renaissance Global Limited published extracts of their Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. These results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors.

attchmntText: Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited has informed regarding Voluntary Submission of the Compliance Report on Corporate Governance for the Quarter ended 30th September, 2026.
desc: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
